TYPES = {"i8":8, "i16":16, "i32":32}

        vals.append(v)

    vals = list(params)

        kind = rng.random()
        a = rng.choice(vals)
        if kind < 0.45:
            op = rng.choice(["and", "or", "xor"])
            b = str(rng.choice(MASKS + [rng.randrange(0, 1 << w)])) if rng.random() < 0.8 else rng.choice(vals)
            body.append("  %s = %s %s %s, %s" % (nv(), op, t, a, b))
        elif kind < 0.62:
            op = rng.choice(["add", "sub", "mul"])
            fl = rng.choice(["", "", " nuw", " nsw", " nuw nsw"])
            b = str(rng.choice(MASKS)) if rng.random() < 0.6 else rng.choice(vals)
            body.append("  %s = %s%s %s %s, %s" % (nv(), op, fl, t, a, b))
        elif kind < 0.78:
            op = rng.choice(["shl", "lshr", "ashr"])
            fl = (rng.choice(["", "", " nuw", " nsw"]) if op == "shl"
                  else rng.choice(["", "", " exact"]))
            body.append("  %s = %s%s %s %s, %d" % (nv(), op, fl, t, a, rng.randrange(0, w)))
        elif kind < 0.86:
            op = rng.choice(["cttz", "ctlz"])
            body.append("  %s = call %s @llvm.%s.%s(%s %s, i1 false)" % (nv(), t, op, cname(t), t, a))
        elif kind < 0.93:
            body.append("  %s = select i1 %%c0, %s %s, %s %s" % (nv(), t, a, t, rng.choice(vals)))
        else:
            body.append("  %s = and %s %s, %d" % (nv(), t, a, rng.choice(MASKS)))

            s = nv()
            sinks.append("  %s = and %s %s, %d" % (s, t, v, rng.choice(MASKS)))
            sinks.append("  call void @use_%s(%s %s)" % (nm, t, s))
        elif style == 2:
            s = nv()
            sinks.append("  %s = lshr %s %s, %d" % (s, t, v, rng.randrange(1, w)))
            sinks.append("  call void @use_%s(%s %s)" % (nm, t, s))
        elif style == 3:

        else:

            sinks.append("  call void @use_%s(%s %s)" % (nm, t, s))

            sinks.append("  %s = icmp ugt %s %s, %d" % (s, t, v, rng.choice(MASKS)))
            sinks.append("  call void @llvm.assume(i1 %s)" % s)
        elif style == 4 and t != "i8":
            s = nv()
            sinks.append("  %s = trunc %s %s to i8" % (s, t, v))
            sinks.append("  call void @use_i8(i8 %s)" % s)
        elif style == 5:
            sinks.append("  store %s %s, ptr @g" % (t, v))
        else:
            s = nv()
            sinks.append("  %s = mul %s %s, %d" % (s, t, v, rng.choice(MASKS)))
            sinks.append("  call void @use_%s(%s %s)" % (nm, t, s))
    sinks.append("  ret void")
    # remove the bogus %c0 from vals used in body generation of int operands: rebuild
    uses = set()
    for s in sinks + body:
        for tt in TYPES:
            if ("use_%s(" % cname(tt)) in s:
                uses.add(tt)
    hdr = "declare void @llvm.assume(i1 noundef)\n@g = global i64 zeroinitializer\n"
    for tt in sorted(uses):
        hdr += "declare void @use_%s(%s)\n" % (cname(tt), tt)
    return hdr + "define void @f(%s) {\n" % ", ".join("%s %s" % (t, p) for p in params) \
        + "\n".join(body) + "\n" + "\n".join(sinks) + "\n}\n"
